body.message:
We have received a request from the building management regarding scheduled cleaning of the AC duct area in the parking section. To allow the maintenance team to carry out the cleaning safely and without any obstruction, we kindly request you to move your vehicle from the designated parking space for approximately 1 hour.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and greatly appreciate your cooperation and understanding. Once the cleaning has been completed, you may return your vehicle to the parking space.

Thank you for your kind cooperation.
